main_text_excerpt:
In collaboration with NORCE Research and supported by the Norwegian Research Institute, we've employed cutting-edge pressure mapping techniques and robotics to revolutionize the school backpack experience
The Process
3D-scan of the Child
3D-print of the Child's Upper Body
Assembly of Sensory Mat and School Backpack
Testing, Simulated Movements Using Robots
Analyzing Results
We were extra excited seeing how our 1st-2nd grade school backpack, Active Air FLX, performed against competing school backpacks in the market. The back system on the Active Air FLX is based on a combination of air and padding. Below you can see test-results from different school backpacks (time: 30 seconds running, weight in backpack: 2,5 kg + dead weight).
The air cushion in the back of Active Air FLX distributes the pressure more evenly over a larger part of the back and provides a larger contact surface between the backpack and the back. This in turn leads to better support and stability.
When carrying a school backpack, you want to distribute weight from the shoulders to the hips. Therefore, most bags are equipped with a hip belt. This also applies to all the bags we tested. Nevertheless, we see big differences. By looking at the illustrations, it is very clear that Active Air FLX transfers much more of the weight to the hips/pelvic crest, compared to the competing school bags we tested.
From the illustration you can also see how the center of gravity of the bags lies through the testing. It appears with a red dot in the center of the spine. Compared to the competitors, Active Air FLX has a lower center of gravity, which supports that the shoulders carry less, and that more of the weight has been distributed to the hips.
Should I use the hip belt on my Active Air FLX?
As the table illustrates, our findings indicate that more weight is borne by your shoulders.

The back system on the Active Air FLX is based on a combination of air and padding. Below you can see test-results from different school backpacks (time: 30 seconds running, weight in backpack: 2,5 kg + dead weight).
The air cushion in the back of Active Air FLX distributes the pressure more evenly over a larger part of the back and provides a larger contact surface between the backpack and the back. This in turn leads to better support and stability.

Testing, Simulated Movements Using Robots

Analyzing Results
We were extra excited seeing how our 1st-2nd grade school backpack, Active Air FLX, performed against competing school backpacks in the market. The back system on the Active Air FLX is based on a combination of air and padding. Nevertheless, we see big differences. main_text_excerpt:
We recommend washing your backpack by hand with a mild liquid detergent. If you choose to use a washing machine, place the backpack inside a pillowcase to prevent the straps from getting caught, and select a gentle program. Please note that any damage caused by machine washing is not covered by the warranty.
Important: Pencil cases and other accessories should not be washed (either by hand or in a washing machine). Instead, clean them carefully with a damp cloth.
Before washing, please check if any of the items below are relevant to your backpack:
1. Rain Cover and Back Support (almost all backpacks):
Remove both before washing. The aluminium back support is located inside the backpack, against the back, and can be pulled upwards. Remember to reinstall it in the correct direction afterwards. The rain cover is usually placed in the lid, a side pocket, or the bottom.
2. Buttons (Classic, Classic Maxi and Active Air FLX):
These backpack models come with Velcro-attached buttons. Remove them before washing.
3. Blinking Light (Classic):
Some Classic models have a blinking light. Remove it before washing by unscrewing the small screw, twisting it, and removing the battery.
4. Air Cushion (Sport Air and Active Air FLX):
Remove before washing.
Drying & Re-impregnation
Let the backpack air dry. We do not recommend using a tumble dryer.
After washing, we recommend re-impregnating your backpack to restore water resistance (note: does not apply to Street products). Staff at a shoe or sports store can help you choose the right impregnation product. Be aware that some sprays may stain, particularly on dark fabrics. Always test on a small, discreet area first, and follow the instructions on the bottle.
Special care for Street products
Backpacks from our Street series are especially sensitive. For these, do not handwash or machine wash. Instead, use a soft, damp cloth (without any detergent or soap) to gently wipe away stains or watermarks. Please note that any damage caused by the use of soap, liquid detergent, washing powder, or by machine washing is not covered under warranty. Our recommendation on re-impregnation also does not apply to Street products.

main_text_excerpt:
Going from kindergarten to school is a big transition in a child’s life, also when it comes to what backpack to wear. Of course, the backpack has to be bigger, but it will also be used a lot more. Therefore, the backpack needs to offer great carrying comfort, be durable and user-friendly so that the children can handle it themselves.
Carrying Comfort
Did you know that the daily distance walked by a child living 1.5 km from school adds up to the distance from Los Angeles to New York within just 7 school years? Then it is easy to understand that a good backpack is important! Choose a bag to grow out of, not into.
- Does the backpack have a chest strap that can be height adjusted? Adjust it so that it is level with the armpit. The chest strap prevents the backpack from slipping off the shoulders and is important so that the arms can be used freely.
- Does the backpack have a proper hip belt? Most school backpacks have a hip belt, but make sure that there is good padding and a little length of the padding itself. It is the pelvis crest that should carry much of the weight. A proper hip belt also provides good stability and prevents the backpack from moving too much when the child jumps and runs.
- Top tensioners sit on top of the shoulder strap and are important for pulling the backpack and weight towards the shoulder area. Without top tensioners, the weight in the backpack can cause the kid to be pulled back.
- The back should be well padded and follow the shape of the body as much as possible. Beckmann’s backpacks have an anatomically shaped back that allows the backpack to sit close to the body without feeling sharp against the buttocks or tipping away from the neck at the top. Do not choose a bag with a soft back.
Smart solutions
The selection of bags for first grade may look the same on the outside, but it is important that you open the bag and get to know the functions and solutions before making a choice.
How is the inside structure? In order for the backpack to be packed as correctly as possible, with books, tablets, etc. near the back, the division is important. There should be a pocket against the back that holds 2-3 books. Does it have a natural place for a drinking bottle and lunch box?
Also check that the backpack has the included rain cover with its own dedicated space. If it has to be bought loose and does not have its own space, there is a greater chance that it will be lost.
Perhaps the most important thing is that the child is visible on the way to school. Does the backpack have enough reflectors or maybe a light? We also offer extra reflective products that you can use in darker periods during autumn and winter.
Some days the children need to bring extra clothes, perhaps for swimming, hiking or similar. Then it can be easy to use a simple bag, but the disadvantage of this is that it is carried with one hand which makes the distribution of weight skewed, and that the kids do not have their hands free. To avoid this, our gym / hiking bag can easily be attached on top of the school backpack and the weight is then evenly distributed and weight is transferred to the pelvis crest.
A separate small backpack can also be smart to use on hiking days so you do not have to bring the school bag and risk that it becomes very dirty and takes on a smell of fire.
Good luck with your choice!

Does the backpack have a proper hip belt? Most school backpacks have a hip belt, but make sure that there is good padding and a little length of the padding itself. It is the pelvis crest that should carry much of the weight. A proper hip belt also provides good stability and prevents the backpack from moving too much when the child jumps and runs.
Top tensioners sit on top of the shoulder strap and are important for pulling the backpack and weight towards the shoulder area. Without top tensioners, the weight in the backpack can cause the kid to be pulled back.
The back should be well padded and follow the shape of the body as much as possible. Beckmann’s backpacks have an anatomically shaped back that allows the backpack to sit close to the body without feeling sharp against the buttocks or tipping away from the neck at the top. Do not choose a bag with a soft back.


Smart solutions
The selection of bags for first grade may look the same on the outside, but it is important that you open the bag and get to know the functions and solutions before making a choice.
How is the inside structure? In order for the backpack to be packed as correctly as possible, with books, tablets, etc. near the back, the division is important. There should be a pocket against the back that holds 2-3 books. Does it have a natural place for a drinking bottle and lunch box?
Also check that the backpack has the included rain cover with its own dedicated space. If it has to be bought loose and does not have its own space, there is a greater chance that it will be lost.
Perhaps the most important thing is that the child is visible on the way to school. Does the backpack have enough reflectors or maybe a light? We also offer extra reflective products that you can use in darker periods during autumn and winter.
Some days the children need to bring extra clothes, perhaps for swimming, hiking or similar. Then it can be easy to use a simple bag, but the disadvantage of this is that it is carried with one hand which makes the distribution of weight skewed, and that the kids do not have their hands free. To avoid this, our gym / hiking bag can easily be attached on top of the school backpack and the weight is then evenly distributed and weight is transferred to the pelvis crest.
A separate small backpack can also be smart to use on hiking days so you do not have to bring the school bag and risk that it becomes very dirty and takes on a smell of fire.
Good luck with your choice!

title: Sustainabilty Award | Storebrand Real Estate - www.storebrand.com
description: Storebrand Sustainability Award is an annual award, first launched in 2021 in Norway.
main_text_excerpt:
Storebrand Sustainability Award
Storebrand Group has worked with sustainable investments since the late nineties. As Norway's largest private asset manager and one of the largest in the Nordics, the Group uses its position to influence companies to constantly improve, particularly in the area of sustainability.
Rationale for the award
Construction and property are referred to as the 40 percent sector in terms of environmental impact in the world, and the challenges are enormous. Every year, real estate players invest large resources in the development of new and existing buildings. Storebrand Real Estate wants to contribute to the green shift in commercial property, and will promote holistic efforts for environmental, economic and social sustainability.
Storebrand Sustainability Award is an annual award, first launched in 2021 in Norway. Our ambition going forward is to expand the award to Sweden and Denmark.
We have established a sustainability award to recognise real estate players who challenge established practice, lead the way and share their knowledge so that the entire industry can become more sustainable.
Truls Nergaard
Head of Storebrand Real Estate
Award winner 2024:
Vertikal Nydalen
Vertikal Nydalen, Avantor's new tower in Oslo, is a flagship project designed to achieve near zero-energy levels and was honored with the 2024 Storebrand Real Estate Sustainability Award.
Previous winners
Storebrand Sustainability Award 2023
Innoasis / Smedvig Eiendom
Innoasis, Smedvig Eiendom's rehabilitation project in Stavanger, has won the Storebrand Real Estate Sustainability Award 2023.
Storebrand Sustainability Award 2022
The Plus / Vestre
The Norwegian furniture maker Vestre is awarded Storebrand Sustainability Award 2022 for their new hypermodern outdoor furniture factory The Plus.
Storebrand Sustainability Award 2021
Entra
Winner of the Sustainability Award 2021 for the project Kristian Augusts gate 13.

description: Storebrand Real Estate is the gateway and one-stop shop for investments in sustainable Nordic real estate.
main_text_excerpt:
Full life-cycle approach
Our business involves all sides of real estate management throughout the property life cycle.
Services include fund management, asset management, property management, project management and letting services. It also includes thorough work and expertise within ESG as well as technology and innovation management.
Quality in everything we do
When investing in real estate, we focus primarily on a the quality of the location, the standard and potential of the property, and outlooks for cash flow growth.
Nordic reach
We have 70+ real estate professionals working out of offices in Oslo, Stockholm and Copenhagen. Our feet on the ground provide investors with attractive deal flows and investment opportunities.
Our history
Storebrand Real Estate AS is a real estate fund and asset manager licensed as an alternative investment fund manager (AIFM).
We are a subsidiary of Storebrand Asset Management AS and part of the Storebrand Group, which is listed on the Oslo stock exchange and has a history dating back to 1767. The Storebrand Group is recognised globally as a leader in sustainable investment, and has over years been among the top 10% most sustainable listed companies ranked by Dow Jones Sustainability Index.
Sustainability is at the core of our real estate business, and our goal is to is to develop environmentally and socially healthy buildings and workspaces for our tenants and society at a large. Investing in buildings of high quality and with great location has been important from the very beginning, and our portfolios contain some of the most attractive properties and projects.
